title: Go
description: Can write Go network services that handle errors idiomatically and cancel in-flight work — and can use goroutines and channels only where they simplify coordination.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can write a small Go module with functions, interfaces and returned errors, run go test, and name the error path for a failed call — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can build a small HTTP or TCP service that uses goroutines or channels for coordination, propagate context cancellation and a timeout, and submit a go test run that is race-detector clean on the tested paths.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently ship a concurrent Go service whose shutdown cancels in-flight work, whose expected failures return errors rather than panic, and whose tests fail if cancellation or a race is ignored.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a hang, leaked goroutine or data race where a passing test would mislead, cite the race-detector report or a dropped context, and produce a note another engineer can follow to reproduce the fault without reading the whole package first.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's Go service, name a channel used as decoration or a cancelled context that is ignored, and teach when not to use a channel on an unfamiliar package.
